name: Jide 'JBlaze' Oyegbile
bio: Jide ‘JBlaze’ Oyegbile is a medical doctor who is also a fast-rising actor and movie maker in the world’s third-largest movie industry- Nollywood. As an actor, he is notable for his roles in hit movies like “Forbidden”, “Assistant Madams”, “Read it” and Kemi Adetiba’s upcoming movie “King Of Boys 2”. He credits his dedication and popular nature of strict adherence to process and discipline to his passion for art and his medical career. He is an advocate of excellence in African production and is currently taking up responsibilities of movie directing.

Bound by vows but torn apart, 143 the Movie tells a story of friendship, betrayal, loyalty, and love.
